pred: SELECT CAST((MAX(r1.milliseconds) - (SUBSTRING(r2.time, 1, INSTR(r2.time, ':') - 1) * 3600000 + SUBSTRING(r2.time, INSTR(r2.time, ':') + 1, INSTR(r2.time, '.') - INSTR(r2.time, ':') - 1) * 60000 + SUBSTRING(r2.time, INSTR(r2.time, '.') - 2, 3) * 1000 + SUBSTRING(r2.time, INSTR(r2.time, '.') + 1))) AS REAL) * 100 / MAX(r1.milliseconds) AS percentage_difference FROM results AS r1 INNER JOIN races ON r1.raceid = races.raceid INNER JOIN results AS r2 ON r1.raceid = r2.raceid WHERE races.name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND races.year = 2008 AND r2.time LIKE '%:%'
